svg.title: ClickFix techniques, and which are seen at delivery
svg.desc: Six ATT&CK techniques for ClickFix. Seen at delivery: T1566.002 yes, where the lure is an email pointing at the page; T1204.004 yes, as an instruction, not as an execution; T1027 partly, where the message itself is obfuscated. Not seen: T1059.001, T1218.005 and T1105. Same detail as the table below.
